stories.title: Rookie QB Carson Beck delivers efficient debut for Cardinals
stories.summary: Carson Beck completed 15 of 19 passes for 188 yards and a touchdown for a quarterback rating of 125.4 in the Cardinals' 33-30 loss to the Panthers in the Hall of Fame Game.

stories.title: Sean McVay hails Aaron Donald workout as Rams await DT's call
stories.summary: Rams coach Sean McVay said Thursday he doesn't have an answer to whether Aaron Donald will come out of retirement this season but added that the former All-Pro defensive tackle "looked outstanding" during his workout with the team Tuesday.
